bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Canonical USDai issuance remains native to the PYUSD-backed Arbitrum hub. Ethereum, Base, and Plasma use OToken v1.1 implementations whose mint/burn functions require the constructor-fixed LayerZero OAdapter; stored BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE grants no longer authorize token minting in the current logic. Existing reviews establish chain-local Safe adapter owners and 48-hour DVNTimelock proxy upgrades on those three chains. Solana is a verified LayerZero burn-mint representation, but its 1-of-2 SPL mint authority admits an autonomous verified Squads 3-of-3 vault independently of the OFT program, without an onchain timelock. The October 9 Arc review adds the sixth issuer-listed deployment: pinned OToken v1.1 runtime exactly matches the verified Ethereum implementation, and the verified Arc OAdapter burns on debit and mints on credit without canonical token escrow. Arc owner, peer/DVN and upgrade execution-path completeness are not inherited from the other chains. All satellite transfer controls remain Bridge Risk; prior control observations retain their original dates.
